title: Video download dialog
description: Preview and download dialog for captured video output.

ui.overview: The Video download dialog appears after a capture is ready. It gives the user a last check before downloading or sharing the recorded output.

controls.label: Preview area
controls.description: Shows the captured video output before download or sharing.

controls.label: Download
controls.description: Saves the video file to local storage.

controls.label: Share
controls.description: Opens the browser sharing flow when available.

controls.label: Close
controls.description: Dismisses the dialog without changing the output file.

notes: Review the final framing here before handing the media to someone else.
